record.decision: Reserve the rotated card's painted width with margin-inline: calc((var(--card-h) - var(--card-w)) / 2), and KEEP the translate nudge — mirrored per seat — unless looking at the result shows it was only overlap compensation.

payload.body: How does the sideways third card get room, given rotate(90deg) leaves its layout box at card width so its 132px visual overhangs 20px on each side — reserve the space in the flex track, or let it bleed outboard toward the felt rim?
